targets.note: Apps opens on Sites. Each deployed site shows its state, address, last deploy and who deployed it; a failed one says so.
New site: one sheet with GitHub repo, Folder or zip, Ask an agent.
A live CX dashboard: status, address, last deploy and who, deploys with Roll back, env vars from the Vault, its Postgres and the import, access, resources, domains, app log.
A deploy running: the build log updates in place, nothing blinks.
A failed deploy: plain words and one fix button (Add Postgres and deploy). The last good build keeps serving.
